sys.path.insert(0, str(R))
from scripts import capture_page_evidence as capture
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
D = R / ".7592-integration-proof"
OUT = R / "mockups/evidence/china-current-7592-20261111-c4-main3a14"
PROOF = D / "current-capture-proof.json"
CHROME = Path("/Users/chriswong/Library/Caches/ms-playwright/chromium_headless_shell-1234/chrome-headless-shell-mac-arm64/chrome-headless-shell")
def identity(path):
    b = path.read_bytes()
    return {"git_blob": hashlib.sha1(b"blob "+str(len(b)).encode()+b"\0"+b).hexdigest(),
            "sha256": hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(), "bytes": len(b)}
owned = ["collectors/china_breadth.py", "scripts/build_china.py", "templates/china.html.j2",
         "tests/test_china_archetype_d_s1.py", "engine/china_tier1.py",
         "tests/test_risk_radar_dlg_country_wiring.py", "tests/test_china_breadth_coverage.py",
         ".github/ci/legacy-jobs.yml", "site/china.html", "site/assets/css/ad3fe3b7.css",
         "site/assets/css/f7e9b02b.css", "site/factordata/china_standouts.json",
         "scripts/capture_page_evidence.py", "templates/_aibrief_body.html.j2",
         "templates/_aibrief_css.j2", "tests/test_ci_pack.py", "lib/pages.py",
         "scripts/optimize_assets.py", "lib/shared_shell.py"]
proof = {"schema":"mastermind.pr7592.current_capture.v1", "production":False,
         "base":"3a14c93979e780e5f880643efc88b3e1f1625f74",
         "candidate_binding":"actual uncommitted candidate bytes; manifest Git HEAD describes the checkout base",
         "capture_owner": "scripts/capture_page_evidence.py",
         "browser_executable":str(CHROME), "blocked_requests":[], "request_failures":[],
         "observed_cells":[], "servers":[], "browser_closed":False}
servers = []
state = {"origin":None, "cell":None}
before = {}
def save():
    PROOF.write_text(json.dumps(proof, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, indent=2)+"\n")
class GuardedBrowser:
    def __init__(self, browser):
        self.browser = browser
    def new_context(self, **kwargs):
        ctx = self.browser.new_context(**kwargs)
        def route_request(route):
            url = urlsplit(route.request.url)
            if (url.scheme, url.netloc) == state["origin"]:
                route.continue_()
            else:
                proof["blocked_requests"].append({"cell":state["cell"],"url":route.request.url})
                route.abort("blockedbyclient")
        ctx.route("**/*", route_request)
        ctx.on("requestfailed", lambda req: proof["request_failures"].append(
            {"cell":state["cell"],"url":req.url,"failure":req.failure}))
        return ctx
    def close(self):
        self.browser.close()
        proof["browser_closed"] = not self.browser.is_connected()
class Driver(capture._PlaywrightDriver):
    def capture(self, *, url, cell, timeout_s):
        parsed = urlsplit(url)
        assert parsed.scheme == "http" and parsed.hostname == "127.0.0.1"
        state["origin"] = (parsed.scheme, parsed.netloc)
        state["cell"] = cell.cell_id
        observation = super().capture(url=url, cell=cell, timeout_s=timeout_s)
        proof["observed_cells"].append({
            "cell":cell.cell_id, "viewport":cell.viewport,"width":cell.width,"height":cell.height,
            "theme":cell.theme,"locale":cell.locale,"loaded":observation.loaded,
            "applied_theme":observation.applied_theme,"applied_locale":observation.applied_locale,
            "observed":observation.observed,"error":observation.error})
        save()
        return observation
def factory(*, headless, user_agent, observer_config, settle_ms):
    manager = sync_playwright().start()
    try:
        browser = manager.chromium.launch(executable_path=str(CHROME), headless=headless)
    except Exception as exc:
        manager.stop()
        raise capture.CaptureUnavailable(str(exc)) from exc
    proof["browser_version"] = browser.version

    httpd, port = original_serve(site_dir)
    servers.append((httpd,port))
    return httpd,port
capture.serve_site_dir = tracked_serve
exit_code = 1
try:
    assert not OUT.exists(), "Fresh evidence path already exists; reconcile before any further capture."
    assert CHROME.is_file() and os.access(CHROME, os.X_OK)
    with socket.socket() as server:
        server.bind(("127.0.0.1",0)); server.listen(1)
        with socket.socket() as client:
            client.settimeout(2); client.connect(server.getsockname())
            peer,_ = server.accept(); peer.close()
    with socket.socket() as outside:
        outside.settimeout(1)
        try:
            outside.connect(("192.0.2.1",443))
        except OSError as exc:
            assert exc.errno in (errno.EPERM,errno.EACCES), repr(exc)
            proof["network_boundary"]={"loopback_pair":True,"outside_test_net_denied":True,"errno":exc.errno}
        else:
            raise AssertionError("Outside destination was unexpectedly reachable")
    proof["sandbox_profile"] = identity(R/".7592-integration-proof/loopback-capture.sb")
    before = {p:identity(R/p) for p in owned}
    assert before["site/china.html"]["git_blob"] == "fa3fc88f9970e94aedf6a1009645eab2a142a819"
    proof["browser_executable_identity"] = identity(CHROME)
    proof["operation"] = "macro-pr7592-integration-20261111-c4-2f7053"
    proof["before"] = before
    save()
    code = capture.main(["--site-dir",str(R/"site"),"--routes","/china.html","--max-pages","1",
                         "--viewports","desktop,mobile","--locales","en,zh","--themes","dark,light",
                         "--settle-ms","1200","--timeout-s","30","--output-dir",str(OUT),
                         "--manifest",str(OUT/"manifest.json"),"--smells",str(OUT/"smells.json")],
                        driver_factory=factory)
    proof["capture_exit_code"] = code
    assert code == 0
    manifest = json.loads((OUT/"manifest.json").read_text())
    assert manifest["schema"] == "mastermind.p0_evidence.v2"
    assert manifest["totals"]["states_attempted"] == manifest["totals"]["states_captured"] == 8
    assert len(manifest["pages"]) == 1
    states = manifest["pages"][0]["states"]
    assert len(states) == 8
    checked = []
    for item in states:
        assert item["captured"]
        assert item["applied_theme"] == item["theme"]
        assert item["applied_locale"] == item["locale"]
        png = (OUT/item["file"]).resolve()
        assert png.is_relative_to(OUT)
        raw = png.read_bytes()
        assert raw[:8] == b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n"
        assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == item["sha256"]
        assert len(raw) == item["bytes"]
        width,height = struct.unpack(">II",raw[16:24])
        assert (width,height) == (item["width"],item["height"])
        checked.append({"file":item["file"],"sha256":item["sha256"],"bytes":len(raw),
                        "width":width,"height":height,"theme":item["theme"],"locale":item["locale"]})
    proof["screenshots"] = checked
    proof["console_errors"] = manifest["pages"][0].get("console_errors",[])
    proof["failed_responses"] = manifest["pages"][0].get("failed_responses",[])
    proof["manifest"] = identity(OUT/"manifest.json")
    proof["smells"] = identity(OUT/"smells.json")
    proof["status"] = "eight_actual_rest_cells_verified"
    exit_code = 0
except BaseException as exc:
    proof["status"] = "failed"
    proof["exception"] = type(exc).__name__+": "+str(exc)
    traceback.print_exc()
finally:
    for httpd,port in servers:
        httpd.shutdown()
        httpd.server_close()
        refused = False
        with socket.socket() as probe:
            probe.settimeout(1)
            try: probe.connect(("127.0.0.1",port))
            except ConnectionRefusedError: refused = True
        proof["servers"].append({"port":port,"closed":refused})
    after = {p:identity(R/p) for p in before}
    proof["after"] = after
    proof["candidate_bytes_unchanged"] = bool(before) and before == after
    if before and before != after:
        exit_code = 1
        proof["status"] = "candidate_bytes_changed"
    save()
    print(json.dumps({k:proof.get(k) for k in ("status","capture_exit_code","network_boundary",
        "browser_version","browser_closed","candidate_bytes_unchanged","servers","exception")},indent=2))
sys.exit(exit_code)

"""Eight explicit synthetic truth cases against the current China template."""
from pathlib import Path
import errno, hashlib, http.server, json, os, socket, sys, threading, traceback
from urllib.parse import urlsplit
R = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
os.chdir(R)
sys.path[:0] = [str(R), str(R/"tests")]
from test_china_archetype_d_s1 import _render_china_risk_case
from scripts import capture_page_evidence as capture
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
D = R/".7592-integration-proof"
WORK = D/"synthetic-current"
OUT = R/"mockups/evidence/china-current-7592-20261111-c4-main3a14"
BROWSER = Path("/Users/chriswong/Library/Caches/ms-playwright/chromium_headless_shell-1234/chrome-headless-shell-mac-arm64/chrome-headless-shell")
def identity(p):
    b=p.read_bytes()
    return {"git_blob":hashlib.sha1(b"blob "+str(len(b)).encode()+b"\0"+b).hexdigest(),
            "sha256":hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),"bytes":len(b)}
paths=["engine/china_tier1.py","scripts/build_china.py","templates/china.html.j2",
       "templates/china_risk_state_live.js","tests/test_china_archetype_d_s1.py","site/china.html",
       "templates/_aibrief_body.html.j2","templates/_aibrief_css.j2"]
before={p:identity(R/p) for p in paths}
assert before["site/china.html"]["git_blob"]=="fa3fc88f9970e94aedf6a1009645eab2a142a819"
assert not WORK.exists(), "Fresh synthetic work directory already exists; reconcile before further execution."
site=WORK/"site";site.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
for source in (R/"site").iterdir():
    if source.name!="china.html":
        (site/source.name).symlink_to(source,target_is_directory=source.is_dir())
html=_render_china_risk_case(None)
(site/"china.html").write_text(html,encoding="utf-8")
feed={"schema":"china_risk_state.v1","built":"2026-11-11T17:00:00Z","nightly_asof":"2026-11-11",
      "live_active":False,"realtime":False,
      "display":{"score":38,"verdict":"RISK_OFF","label_en":"Risk-off","label_zh":"避险"},
      "nightly":{"verdict":"RISK_OFF","headline_en":"Synthetic refreshed headline","headline_zh":"合成刷新标题"}}
proof={"schema":"mastermind.pr7592.synthetic_interaction.v1","proof_class":"synthetic_full_page_browser",
       "production":False,"fixture_notice":"Rendered from the actual current test helper; the injected feed is synthetic.",
       "base":"3a14c93979e780e5f880643efc88b3e1f1625f74","browser_executable":str(BROWSER),
       "before":before,"fixture_html":identity(site/"china.html"),"feed":feed,
       "browser_executable_identity":identity(BROWSER),"operation":"macro-pr7592-integration-20261111-c4-2f7053",
       "cases":[],"blocked_requests":[],"request_failures":[],"console_errors":[],
       "failed_responses":[],"browser_closed":False,"local_server_closed":False}
class Handler(http.server.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler):
    def __init__(self,*a,**kw):super().__init__(*a,directory=str(site),**kw)
    def log_message(self,*a):pass
server=http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1",0),Handler)
thread=threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever,daemon=True);thread.start()
origin=("http",f"127.0.0.1:{server.server_port}")
code=1
try:
    with socket.socket() as s:
        s.settimeout(1)
        try:s.connect(("192.0.2.1",443))
        except OSError as exc:
            assert exc.errno in (errno.EPERM,errno.EACCES)
            proof["outside_test_net_denied"]={"denied":True,"errno":exc.errno}
        else:raise AssertionError("External destination unexpectedly reachable")
    with sync_playwright() as manager:
        browser=manager.chromium.launch(executable_path=str(BROWSER),headless=True)
        proof["browser_version"]=browser.version
        try:
            for width,height in ((1440,900),(390,844)):
                for theme in ("dark","light"):
                    for locale in ("en","zh"):
                        cell=f"{width}x{height}|{theme}|{locale}"
                        context=browser.new_context(viewport={"width":width,"height":height},
                            locale="zh-CN" if locale=="zh" else "en-US",color_scheme=theme,
                            device_scale_factor=1)
                        try:
                            context.add_init_script(capture.state_seed_source({"theme":theme,"locale":locale}))
                            def route_request(route):
                                parsed=urlsplit(route.request.url)
                                if (parsed.scheme,parsed.netloc)!=origin:
                                    proof["blocked_requests"].append({"cell":cell,"url":route.request.url})
                                    route.abort("blockedbyclient")
                                elif parsed.path=="/live/china_risk_state.json":
                                    route.fulfill(status=200,content_type="application/json",body=json.dumps(feed))
                                else:route.continue_()
                            context.route("**/*",route_request)
                            page=context.new_page()
                            page.on("requestfailed",lambda req:proof["request_failures"].append(
                                {"cell":cell,"url":req.url,"failure":req.failure}))
                            page.on("console",lambda msg:proof["console_errors"].append(
                                {"cell":cell,"text":msg.text}) if msg.type=="error" else None)
                            page.on("pageerror",lambda err:proof["console_errors"].append(
                                {"cell":cell,"text":"pageerror: "+str(err)}))
                            page.on("response",lambda response:proof["failed_responses"].append(
                                {"cell":cell,"url":response.url,"status":response.status}) if response.status>=400 else None)
                            page.goto(f"http://{origin[1]}/china.html",wait_until="domcontentloaded",timeout=30000)
                            page.wait_for_function("document.querySelector('.v-thesis .l-en')?.textContent === 'Synthetic refreshed headline'",timeout=30000)
                            applied=page.evaluate(capture._APPLY_STATE_SCRIPT.strip(),{"theme":theme,"locale":locale})
                            assert applied.get("theme")==theme and applied.get("locale")==locale
                            page.wait_for_timeout(1200)
                            card=page.locator(".cnx-card").filter(has=page.locator(".cnx-ctitle",has_text="Pullback Risk"))
                            slow=card.locator(".cnx-kv").filter(has_text="Economic slowdown").locator(".v")
                            slowdown=slow.inner_text().strip()
                            assert slowdown.lower() in ("unavailable","暂不可用"),slowdown
                            guidance=card.locator(".cnx-foot").inner_text()
                            assert "size down" not in guidance.lower() and "缩仓" not in guidance
                            assert "unavailable" in guidance.lower() or "暂不可用" in guidance
                            playbook=page.locator(".cnx-playbook-context").text_content()
                            assert "Playbook posture unavailable." in playbook
                            assert "Synthetic refreshed" not in playbook
                            assert page.locator(".v-thesis .l-zh").text_content()=="合成刷新标题"
                            overflow=page.evaluate("document.documentElement.scrollWidth > innerWidth")
                            assert not overflow
                            card.click()
                            assert page.locator("#cnx-dlg-risk").is_visible()
                            proof["cases"].append({"width":width,"height":height,"theme":theme,"locale":locale,
                                "applied":applied,"slowdown":slowdown,"guidance":guidance,
                                "headline_refreshed":True,"playbook_preserved":True,
                                "risk_dialog_opened":True,"horizontal_overflow":overflow})
                        finally:context.close()
        finally:
            browser.close()
            proof["browser_closed"]=not browser.is_connected()
    assert len(proof["cases"])==8
    proof["status"]="passed"
    code=0
except BaseException as exc:
    proof["status"]="failed";proof["exception"]=type(exc).__name__+": "+str(exc)
    traceback.print_exc()
finally:
    server.shutdown();server.server_close();thread.join(timeout=5)
    with socket.socket() as probe:
        probe.settimeout(1)
        try:probe.connect(("127.0.0.1",server.server_port))
        except ConnectionRefusedError:proof["local_server_closed"]=not thread.is_alive()
    proof["after"]={p:identity(R/p) for p in paths}
    proof["candidate_bytes_unchanged"]=proof["before"]==proof["after"]
    if not proof["candidate_bytes_unchanged"]:code=1;proof["status"]="candidate_bytes_changed"
    (D/"synthetic-current-result.json").write_text(json.dumps(proof,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n")
    if code==0:
        (OUT/"interaction-proof.json").write_text(json.dumps(proof,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n")
    print(json.dumps({k:proof.get(k) for k in ("status","browser_version","browser_closed",
        "local_server_closed","candidate_bytes_unchanged","exception")},indent=2))
    print("SYNTHETIC_CASES",len(proof["cases"]))
sys.exit(code)
